title: Fluorspar versus fluorosilicic acid for electronic-grade hydrogen fluoride: model, data, and figure scripts
description: Process model, input tables, Monte Carlo results, and figure scripts for the article 'Fluorspar versus fluorosilicic acid for electronic-grade hydrogen fluoride: A grade-resolved techno-economic, life-cycle, and impurity assessment' (Resources, Conservation and Recycling, submitted). The model compares hydrogen fluoride made from mined fluorspar with hydrogen fluoride made from fluorosilicic acid at three purity grades for a Korean reference site, and reports unit production cost and greenhouse gas emissions.
